summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the Categories Popover feature. All 13 test cases passed. The Explore button with Grid3X3 icon is correctly positioned in the header between search bar and Dense button. The popover opens with dark theme styling, shows market selector tabs (All, US, India), scrollable categories list with icons, and Create Custom button. Category navigation and popover close behaviors work correctly on both desktop and mobile viewports.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing pinned stocks (GOOGL, AAPL, MSFT)
